mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM psy_test_record
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM psy_scale WHERE status = '0'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM psy_patient
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM psy_test_record WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()

SELECT IFNULL(ps.scale_name, '未知量表') AS name, COUNT(tr.record_id) AS value FROM psy_test_record tr LEFT JOIN psy_scale ps ON tr.scale_id = ps.scale_id GROUP BY tr.scale_id, ps.scale_name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT IFNULL(tr.level, '未知') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM psy_test_record tr GROUP BY tr.level ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS day, COUNT(1) AS value FROM psy_test_record WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY day
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM psy_follow_up
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM psy_follow_up WHERE status = '已完成'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM psy_follow_up WHERE status = '待随访' AND follow_date < CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(tag, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM psy_patient GROUP BY tag

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM psy_chat_message c WHERE c.sender_role = 'student' AND c.is_read = 0
AND c.student_id IN ( SELECT p.user_id FROM psy_patient p WHERE p.user_id IS NOT NULL AND (p.teacher_id = #{teacherId} OR p.teacher_id IS NULL) )

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM psy_follow_up f WHERE f.status != '已完成' AND f.follow_date < CURDATE()
AND f.user_id IN ( SELECT p.user_id FROM psy_patient p WHERE p.user_id IS NOT NULL AND (p.teacher_id = #{teacherId} OR p.teacher_id IS NULL) )

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM psy_test_record tr WHERE (tr.doctor_conclusion IS NULL OR tr.doctor_conclusion = '') AND (tr.level LIKE '%中度%' OR tr.level LIKE '%重度%')
AND tr.user_id IN ( SELECT p.user_id FROM psy_patient p WHERE p.user_id IS NOT NULL AND (p.teacher_id = #{teacherId} OR p.teacher_id IS NULL) )

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM psy_test_record tr WHERE (tr.level LIKE '%中度%' OR tr.level LIKE '%重度%') AND tr.create_time >= #{weekStart}
AND tr.user_id IN ( SELECT p.user_id FROM psy_patient p WHERE p.user_id IS NOT NULL AND (p.teacher_id = #{teacherId} OR p.teacher_id IS NULL) )
